For visitors

MTB helmet and lights required. Knee pads and eye protection are suggested. Landry’s lists the same ride, meeting 5:30 pm at Houghton’s Pond with the ride starting at 6:00 pm.

First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 5:45 pm. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Intermediate to advanced.
Check
Look at the host’s website the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Thursduro Enduro Night at Blue Hills group ride

Thursduro Enduro Night at Blue Hills is a mountain bike group ride in Milton, MA. It rolls every Thursday at 5:45 pm from Houghton’s Pond area, 840 Hillside St.

A weekly night enduro ride at Blue Hills Reservation, run with Landry’s Braintree store. It takes in the harder technical features and downhill trails. Intermediate to advanced, full-suspension bikes.
